prompt_en: Create a photographic three-quarter seated portrait of one adult woman, using the supplied portrait only for visible adult facial appearance and long dark wavy hair. She is checking a pocket watch immediately before the studio portrait exposure in an opening-era historical photographic atelier with a wooden bellows camera and painted backdrop. Her tailored Western formal clothing comprises a fitted charcoal wool frock coat with long divided tails, a high-collared ivory blouse, an ivory silk cravat, a fitted waistcoat, and a long dark skirt. The coat silhouette, collar construction, cravat knot, and restrained antique studio furnishings make the historical transitional fashion immediately visible. Seated sideways on a carved wooden chair, she holds an open gold pocket watch at upper waist height with its round dial facing the viewer; her gaze drops toward the dial while her other hand lightly touches the chain leading to a waistcoat pocket. The watch lid is visibly open, the chain has a continuous route, and both hands perform this single coherent action. A wooden bellows camera on its tripod stands behind her to the left, its dark focusing cloth hanging from the rear, while the painted architectural canvas fills the far wall. Late afternoon amber side light reveals fine wool texture and separates the ivory cravat from the collar; soft shadow preserves her recognizable facial proportions. Prioritize the clear watch-reading action, the full tailored coat structure and historical studio equipment together in the same frame, and the reference-visible facial appearance. Render realistic skin, believable fabric weight, warm subdued color and fine photographic grain. Keep the complete seated coat tails inside the lower border and place the watch clear of the dark coat. A narrow amber reflection crosses the gold lid while a softer reflected glow lights the dial, separating its two circular surfaces.
